navigator_mapping_note: G3d: how the navigator map draws a row: the setting navigator_mapping says, per channel, which measure of the row it shows (channel -> measure name, or channel -> {measure, range?, missing?, curve?} for a finer choice). Everything here is a preset and an open list: 'channels' are the channels the map really draws (an unknown channel in the setting raises the advisory channel_unknown, it is never refused); 'measures' are the measures with words (any other name is read as a dotted path into the row, e.g. receipt.tokens_est or counts.nodes.value - an attribute no row has raises measure_missing and the channel's 'missing' value is drawn). A text value (a category) on a colour channel takes that component of the colour of the category (the same palette as the list's kinds); on any other channel its rank among the distinct values of the level spread over 'range'. A number on a channel with curve log1p is base + gain * log10(1 + v) (absolute: the same count is the same size on every level), with curve linear it is spread over 'range' from the smallest to the largest value of the level (equal values = the middle), with curve rank by its place among the level's distinct numbers (an outlier does not squash the rest). A missing value draws 'missing'. 'default' is the shipped mapping and reproduces the map of M1-W0 exactly (hue/saturation/lightness from the kind, size from the count, alpha not mapped); the focus is the anchor: it keeps size focus_size. Reverse: delete navigator_mapping (or choose 'Domyślne') = this default.

help.pl: Każdy kanał rysunku pokazuje jedną miarę węzła. Zmiana działa od razu i zapisuje się dla Ciebie.
help.en: Each channel of the drawing shows one measure of a node. A change applies at once and is saved for you.
